\(f_{n}(x){=}\frac{1}{a_{n}\rho(x)}\,\frac{d^{n}}{dx^{n}}(\rho(x)(g(z))^{n})\)

The polynomials given in the following table are the only orthogonal polynomials which satisfy this formula.

\(\begin{array}{c|c|c|c|c}\hline\hline&f_{n}(x)&&a_{n}&&\rho(x)&g(x)\\ \hline\end{array}\)
